plain: Don't let rising prices shrink what you've saved. Put your money in an account that grows as fast as prices go up.
alt: Stop watching inflation chip away at your savings. Switch to an account that keeps pace.
frame_flip: Help your savings hold their full value. Move your money to an account that keeps up with inflation.
reordered: Move your money to an account that keeps up, and don't let inflation eat your savings.
